key_insight: This paper shifts 3D asset generation from making objects that only look realistic to making objects that also move, interact, and function correctly in the physical world. It introduces a multi-agent system, Artisan, that uses simulation feedback to produce more physically grounded articulated assets.
problem_solved: Current 3D generation methods often stop at appearance and geometry, but fail to ensure believable articulation, collision behavior, and functional motion. This paper addresses the challenge of generating articulated 3D assets that are not just visually plausible, but also physically valid and usable.
method: Builds on Articraft with a multi-agent generation pipeline designed for articulated 3D asset creation.
Incorporates physical simulation feedback to refine geometry and articulation toward physically plausible motion.
Targets a broader set of asset qualities, including geometry, appearance, articulation, and collision-free functional behavior.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this work provides a more realistic benchmark and generation framework for embodied and interactive 3D content. It is especially relevant for robotics, simulation, games, and digital twins where physical correctness matters.

paper_title: Towards Physically Grounded Articulated 3D Assets: A Multi-Agent Pipeline and Benchmark
paper_authors: Xudong Cai, Ruijie Zhu, Haoliang Shang, Ruining Li, Marc Pollefeys
